Julie posts cooking videos to 1.2M followers who love her quick, healthy recipes. Over the next three years she wants to grow online and publish a cookbook (torn on traditional vs. self-publishing). She works four days weekly, limited time and budget.

Write a three year plan for Julie about how to grow online and publish her cookbook, taking into account limited time and budget. Also outline the pros and cons of traditional vs. self-publishing.
